name: chrome-devtools-mcp-game

tools.name: asset_monitor_get
tools.description: Query captured asset loading data. Returns summary by file extension (count, size, duration, failures) and recent entries.

sinceMs.description: Only return entries from the last N milliseconds.

maxResults.description: Maximum recent entries to return. Default 30.

tools.name: asset_monitor_start
tools.description: Install an asset loading interceptor that tracks fetch, XHR, and PerformanceObserver resource timing. Use asset_monitor_get to query captured data. Covers textures, audio, scripts, 3D models, fonts, WASM.

tools.name: browser_connect
tools.description: Generate the plugin configuration to connect to a specific Chrome instance. Takes a userDataDir path or wsEndpoint and outputs the plugin.json args needed. Use browser_discover first to find available instances.

userDataDir.description: Path to Chrome user data directory to connect to.

profile.description: Chrome profile name within the userDataDir (e.g., "Default", "Profile 1").

tools.name: browser_discover
tools.description: Discover available Chrome/Edge browser instances and profiles. Finds: (1) Running Chrome instances with debug ports, (2) MCP persistent profiles with saved sessions, system Chrome profiles. Use the returned --userDataDir or --wsEndpoint to reconnect.

tools.name: canvas_info
tools.description: Get information about all canvas elements on the page: dimensions, DPR, WebGL context details, GPU renderer. Useful for debugging game rendering across different devices.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Clicks on the provided element. For cross-origin iframes (e.g., game canvases), automatically falls back to CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent which penetrates iframe boundaries. Use offsetX/offsetY to click at a specific position within the element (e.g., a button inside a canvas). Coordinates are relative to the element's top-left corner.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

offsetX.description: Horizontal offset from the element's top-left corner in CSS pixels. When provided with offsetY, clicks at this position instead of center. Useful for clicking buttons inside canvas elements.

offsetY.description: Vertical offset from the element's top-left corner in CSS pixels. When provided with offsetX, clicks at this position instead of center. Useful for clicking buttons inside canvas elements.

dblClick.description: Set to true for double clicks. Default is false.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: close_page
tools.description: Closes the page by its index. The last open page cannot be closed.

pageId.description: The ID of the page to close. Call list_pages to list pages.

tools.name: console_intercept_start
tools.description: Install a console interceptor that captures all console.log/info/warn/error/debug calls into a buffer. Use console_search to query captured messages. Messages persist until page navigation or console_intercept_stop.

tools.name: console_intercept_stop
tools.description: Clear the console capture buffer. Does not uninstall the interceptor (messages will continue to be captured).

tools.name: console_search
tools.description: Search captured console messages by text content and/or type. Requires console_intercept_start to be called first to install the interceptor. Returns matching messages with timestamps.

query.description: Text to search for (case-insensitive substring match).

types.description: Comma-separated list of message types to filter: log,info,warn,error,debug,dir,table,trace. Default: all types.

sinceMs.description: Only return messages from the last N milliseconds. Default: all messages.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Default 50.

tools.name: console_stats
tools.description: Show statistics about captured console messages: total count, breakdown by type, time range.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag an element onto another element

from_uid.description: The uid of the element to drag

to_uid.description: The uid of the element to drop into

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: emulate
tools.description: Emulates various features on the selected page.

networkConditions.description: Throttle network. Omit to disable throttling.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: Represents the CPU slowdown factor. Omit or set the rate to 1 to disable throttling

geolocation.description: Geolocation (`<latitude>,<longitude>`) to emulate. Latitude between -90 and 90. Longitude between -180 and 180. Omit to clear the geolocation override.

userAgent.description: User agent to emulate. Set to empty string to clear the user agent override.

colorScheme.description: Emulate the dark or the light mode. Set to "auto" to reset to the default.

viewport.description: Emulate device viewports '<width>x<height>x<devicePixelRatio>[,mobile][,touch][,landscape]'. 'touch' and 'mobile' to emulate mobile devices. 'landscape' to emulate landscape mode.

extraHttpHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers as a JSON string object, e.g. {"X-Custom": "value", "Authorization": "Bearer token"}. Headers are included into every HTTP request originating from the page and persist across navigations until cleared. Pass an empty string to clear all extra headers.

tools.name: evaluate_script
tools.description:
Evaluate a JavaScript function inside the currently selected page. Returns the response as JSON,
so returned values have to be JSON-serializable.

items.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

args.description: An optional list of arguments to pass to the function.

filePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a file to save the script output to. If omitted, the output is returned inline.

dialogAction.description: Handle dialogs while execution. "accept", "dismiss", or string for response of window.prompt. Defaults to accept.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Type text into an input, text area or select an option from a <select> element.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

value.description: The value to fill in. "true" or "false" for checkboxes and toggles, "true" for radio buttons.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fill out multiple form elements (inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios) at once. ALWAYS prefer this tool over multiple individual 'fill' or 'click' calls when interacting with forms. It is significantly faster, more reliable, and reduces turn count. Example: Fill username, password, and check "Remember Me" in one call.

uid.description: The uid of the element to fill out

value.description: Value for the element. "true" or "false" for checkboxes and toggles, "true" for radio buttons.

elements.description: Elements from snapshot to fill out.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: game_state
tools.description: Inspect game internal state. Supports presets: "screen" (current page/screen), "dom" (DOM element counts), "console" (game framework globals), "performance" (resource stats). Or provide a custom JavaScript function to read any game variable.

preset.description: Built-in query preset. If provided, "function" is ignored.

function.description: Custom JavaScript function to evaluate. Must return a JSON-serializable value. Example: "() => window.__gameState"

pretty.description: Pretty-print the JSON output. Default true.

tools.name: game_stats
tools.description: Measure real-time game performance: FPS, frame time percentiles (avg/min/max/p50/p95/p99), and JS memory usage. Collects data via requestAnimationFrame sampling for the specified duration. Returns JSON with performance metrics.

durationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds to collect frame samples. Default 1000ms. Range 100-5000.

maxSamples.description: Maximum number of frame samples to collect. Default 120.

tools.name: game_test
tools.description: Run an automated game test with multiple steps. Supports: navigate, wait, wait_for, wait_for_canvas, click, screenshot (with baseline comparison), eval (run JS), assert_text, assert_no_errors. Steps execute sequentially. Screenshots can compare against baselines with pixel tolerance for animated content.

steps.description: JSON array of test steps. Each step: {action, url?, name?, text?, function?, present?, x?, y?, timeMs?, timeout?, format?, quality?, baseline?, tolerance?, threshold?}. Actions: navigate, wait, wait_for, wait_for_canvas, click, screenshot, eval, assert_text, assert_no_errors.

baselineDir.description: Directory to store baseline screenshots for comparison. Defaults to ./test-baselines/

tools.name: get_console_message
tools.description: Gets a console message by its ID. You can get all messages by calling list_console_messages.

msgid.description: The msgid of a console message on the page from the listed console messages

tools.name: get_network_request
tools.description: Gets a network request by an optional reqid, if omitted returns the currently selected request in the DevTools Network panel.

reqid.description: The reqid of the network request. If omitted returns the currently selected request in the DevTools Network panel.

requestFilePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a .network-request file to save the request body to. If omitted, the body is returned inline.

responseFilePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a .network-response file to save the response body to. If omitted, the body is returned inline.

tools.name: handle_dialog
tools.description: If a browser dialog was opened, use this command to handle it

action.description: Whether to dismiss or accept the dialog

promptText.description: Optional prompt text to enter into the dialog.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Hover over the provided element

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: inject_game_overlay
tools.description: Inject or remove a real-time FPS/frame-time/memory overlay on the page. The overlay is a semi-transparent HUD in the top-right corner showing live performance metrics.

action.description: "start" to inject the overlay, "stop" to remove it.

tools.name: keyboard_sequence
tools.description: Press a sequence of keys or key combinations. Each entry can be a single key or a combo like "Control+S". Useful for testing keyboard shortcuts and multi-key game controls.

keys.description: Array of keys or key combos to press in order, e.g. ["Tab", "Tab", "Enter"] or ["Control+S", "Control+Z"]

delayMs.description: Delay between each key press in milliseconds. Default is 0.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: lighthouse_audit
tools.description: Get Lighthouse score and reports for accessibility, SEO, best practices, and agentic browsing. This excludes performance. For performance audits, run performance_start_trace

outputDirPath.description: Directory for reports. If omitted, uses temporary files.

tools.name: list_console_messages
tools.description: List all console messages for the currently selected page since the last navigation.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, returns all messages.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

types.description: Filter messages to only return messages of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all messages.

includePreservedMessages.description: Set to true to return the preserved messages over the last 3 navigations.

serviceWorkerId.description: Filter messages to only return messages of the specified service worker.

tools.name: list_network_requests
tools.description: List all requests for the currently selected page since the last navigation.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of requests to return. When omitted, returns all requests.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

resourceTypes.description: Filter requests to only return requests of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all requests.

includePreservedRequests.description: Set to true to return the preserved requests over the last 3 navigations.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Get a list of pages open in the browser.

tools.name: mouse_move
tools.description: Move the mouse cursor without clicking. Useful for triggering hover states.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: navigate_page
tools.description: Go to a URL, or back, forward, or reload. Use project URL if not specified otherwise.

type.description: Navigate the page by URL, back or forward in history, or reload.

ignoreCache.description: Whether to ignore cache on reload.

handleBeforeUnload.description: Whether to auto accept or beforeunload dialogs triggered by this navigation. Default is accept.

initScript.description: A JavaScript script to be executed on each new document before any other scripts for the next navigation.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

tools.name: new_page
tools.description: Open a new tab and load a URL. Use project URL if not specified otherwise.

url.description: URL to load in a new page.

background.description: Whether to open the page in the background without bringing it to the front. Default is false (foreground).

isolatedContext.description: If specified, the page is created in an isolated browser context with the given name. Pages in the same browser context share cookies and storage. Pages in different browser contexts are fully isolated.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

tools.name: performance_analyze_insight
tools.description: Provides more detailed information on a specific Performance Insight of an insight set that was highlighted in the results of a trace recording.

insightSetId.description: The id for the specific insight set. Only use the ids given in the "Available insight sets" list.

insightName.description: The name of the Insight you want more information on. For example: "DocumentLatency" or "LCPBreakdown"

tools.name: performance_start_trace
tools.description: Start a performance trace on the selected webpage. Use to find frontend performance issues, Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), and improve page load speed.

reload.description: Determines if, once tracing has started, the current selected page should be automatically reloaded. Navigate the page to the right URL using the navigate_page tool BEFORE starting the trace if reload or autoStop is set to true.

autoStop.description: Determines if the trace recording should be automatically stopped.

filePath.description: The absolute file path, or a file path relative to the current working directory, to save the raw trace data. For example, trace.json.gz (compressed) or trace.json (uncompressed).

tools.name: performance_stop_trace
tools.description: Stop the active performance trace recording on the selected webpage.

filePath.description: The absolute file path, or a file path relative to the current working directory, to save the raw trace data. For example, trace.json.gz (compressed) or trace.json (uncompressed).

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key or key combination. Use this when other input methods like fill() cannot be used (e.g., keyboard shortcuts, navigation keys, or special key combinations).

key.description: A key or a combination (e.g., "Enter", "Control+A", "Control++", "Control+Shift+R"). Modifiers: Control, Shift, Alt, Meta

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: resize_page
tools.description: Resizes the selected page's window so that the page has specified dimension

tools.name: screenshot_diff
tools.description: Compare the current viewport screenshot against a baseline image file. Returns pixel-level diff statistics including diff percentage, max color distance, and bounding boxes of changed regions. Optionally saves a diff visualization image. Useful for automated game UI regression testing and animation frame comparison.

baselinePath.description: Path to the baseline (reference) image file to compare against.

tolerance.description: Per-pixel color distance tolerance (Euclidean in RGB space, 0-765). 0 = exact match, 30 = slight anti-aliasing allowed, 100 = aggressive tolerance for animations. Default 30.

alphaTolerance.description: Alpha channel tolerance (0-255). Useful when compositing causes alpha differences. Default 50.

saveDiffTo.description: Path to save the diff visualization image (PNG). Red pixels show differences, gray pixels show matches.

maxRegions.description: Maximum number of diff regions to report. Default 5.

tools.name: select_page
tools.description: Select a page as a context for future tool calls.

pageId.description: The ID of the page to select. Call list_pages to get available pages.

bringToFront.description: Whether to focus the page and bring it to the top.

tools.name: take_heapsnapshot
tools.description: Capture a heap snapshot of the currently selected page. Use to analyze the memory distribution of JavaScript objects and debug memory leaks.

filePath.description: A path to a .heapsnapshot file to save the heapsnapshot to.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the page or element.

format.description: Type of format to save the screenshot as. Default is "png". Use "jpeg" or "webp" with quality for smaller files.

quality.description: Compression quality for JPEG and WebP formats (0-100). Higher values mean better quality but larger file sizes. Ignored for PNG format. Recommended: 80 for JPEG, 85 for WebP.

maxWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels. The screenshot will be downscaled to fit within this width while preserving aspect ratio. Useful for reducing file size.

maxHeight.description: Maximum height in pixels. The screenshot will be downscaled to fit within this height while preserving aspect ratio.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot. If omitted, takes a page screenshot.

fullPage.description: If set to true takes a screenshot of the full page instead of the currently visible viewport. Incompatible with uid.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the screenshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

tools.name: take_snapshot
tools.description:
Take a text snapshot of the currently selected page based on the a11y tree. The snapshot lists page elements along with a unique
identifier (uid). Always use the latest snapshot. Prefer taking a snapshot over taking a screenshot. The snapshot indicates the element selected
in the DevTools Elements panel (if any).

verbose.description: Whether to include all possible information available in the full a11y tree. Default is false.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the snapshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text using keyboard into a previously focused input

submitKey.description: Optional key to press after typing. E.g., "Enter", "Tab", "Escape"

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file through a provided element.

uid.description: The uid of the file input element or an element that will open file chooser on the page from the page content snapshot

filePath.description: The local path of the file to upload

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait for the specified text to appear on the selected page.

text.description: Non-empty list of texts. Resolves when any value appears on the page.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

tools.name: websocket_monitor_get
tools.description: Get captured WebSocket events. Returns lifecycle events (created, handshake, closed) and message frames.

types.description: Filter by event types. When omitted, returns all events.

maxEvents.description: Maximum number of events to return. Default 50.

tools.name: websocket_monitor_start
tools.description: Start monitoring WebSocket activity on the page via CDP Network domain. Captures: connection creation, handshake, frames sent/received, and closures. Call websocket_monitor_stop to detach. Events are stored in memory and can be queried with websocket_monitor_get.

tools.name: websocket_monitor_stop
tools.description: Stop WebSocket monitoring and detach CDP Network listeners.

stderr:
chrome-devtools-mcp exposes content of the browser instance to the MCP clients allowing them to inspect,
debug, and modify any data in the browser or DevTools.
Avoid sharing sensitive or personal information that you do not want to share with MCP clients.
Performance tools may send trace URLs to the Google CrUX API to fetch real-user experience data. To disable, run with --no-performance-crux.

Google collects usage statistics to improve Chrome DevTools MCP. To opt-out, run with --no-usage-statistics.
For more details, visit: https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp#usage-statistics
